rationale: The gate every scored repository must clear, stated only in absolute defect counts. Defaults are strict: a judged repository must answer every judged pair correctly. Each entry under `repos` is an admission that a defect shipped and is tracked - the same ratchet as corpus/known-failures.json. Numbers move one way only: a threshold is tightened when the engine improves, never loosened to make a run pass. Deleting an entry, by fixing the defect, is the only correct exit. A minimum-score percentage is deliberately not available here: the score is `100 * (judged - false negatives - false positives) / judged`, so a percentage is a defect allowance divided by the register size, and the identical number silently permits proportionally more defects every time the register grows. Counts mean the same thing at every register size.
